LanguageData.Geopol_Activiste.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has decided to dedicate his life to defending causes by justifying {PAWN_pronoun} believes.
LanguageData.Geopol_Activiste.title: Activist
LanguageData.Geopol_Artiste.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is convinced that {PAWN_pronoun} has artistic talent. To help find inspiration, {PAWN_pronoun} tends to use various drugs.
LanguageData.Geopol_Artiste.title: Artist
LanguageData.Geopol_Bagarreur.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] likes to fight, is it stronger than {PAWN_gender? him: her}, it made {PAWN_gender? him: her} stronger but also caused some brain damage from the beatings {PAWN_gender? he: she} received.
LanguageData.Geopol_Bagarreur.title: Brawler
LanguageData.Geopol_Banquier.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has spent {PAWN_possessive} life managing other people's money, this made {PAWN_gender? him: her} gifted in the art of negotiating prices.
LanguageData.Geopol_Banquier.title: Banker
LanguageData.Geopol_Boulanger.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] got into the habit of getting up at 3 a.m. every morning to bake bread. {PAWN_pronoun} has become a specialist in the preparation of baguettes.
LanguageData.Geopol_Boulanger.title: Baker
LanguageData.Geopol_Chocolatier.title: Chocolatier
LanguageData.Geopol_Chomeur.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] lost {PAWN_possessive} job a long time ago and never found one. By dint of spending {PAWN_possessive} days on {PAWN_possessive} couch without activity, it has softened the brain of [PAWN_nameDef].
LanguageData.Geopol_Chomeur.title: Unemployed
LanguageData.Geopol_Etudiant.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is studying at university. {PAWN_pronoun} spends {PAWN_possessive} days thinking, and has never learned to use his hands.
LanguageData.Geopol_Etudiant.title: Student
LanguageData.Geopol_Croyant.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] lives above all to serve his God.
LanguageData.Geopol_Croyant.title: Believer
LanguageData.Geopol_Hooligan.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] goes to the stadium every weekend, not to enjoy the game but rather to fight with the opposing fans.
LanguageData.Geopol_Hooligan.title: Hooligan
LanguageData.Geopol_Journaliste.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] thinks {PAWN_pronoun}'s a journalist. Despite the fact that {PAWN_pronoun} has no professional diploma or press card, {PAWN_pronoun} likes to go to demonstrations with {PAWN_possessive} camera on the lookout for the slightest police blunder.
LanguageData.Geopol_Journaliste.title: Freelance Journalist
LanguageData.Geopol_Libraire.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] likes to spend {PAWN_possessive} time reading books, so {PAWN_pronoun} has logically made it {PAWN_possessive} job. This prevents {PAWN_objective} from having time to work on {PAWN_possessive} physical condition.
LanguageData.Geopol_Libraire.title: Bookseller
LanguageData.Geopol_Ouvrier.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has worked {PAWN_possessive} whole life in a factory doing repetitive tasks.
LanguageData.Geopol_Ouvrier.title: Laborer
LanguageData.Geopol_Sociologue.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] studied social phenomena and behaviors. He doesn’t even sure why.
LanguageData.Geopol_Sociologue.title: Sociologist
LanguageData.Geopol_Squatteur.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] got used to living in places that didn't belong to {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} had to learn how to perform {PAWN_objective}-even repairs in property that {PAWN_pronoun} occupied, but does not understand the concept of cleaning.
LanguageData.Geopol_Squatteur.title: Squatter
LanguageData.Geopol_Sreet_Medic.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spends most of his free time in disguise as a military doctor during public demonstrations to rush to the aid of people injured by the police.
LanguageData.Geopol_Sreet_Medic.title: Street Medic
LanguageData.Geopol_Dictateur.baseDesc: After taking power in his country, [PAWN_nameDef] never returned it. {PAWN_pronoun} holds all the power, and rules with an iron fist.
LanguageData.Geopol_Dictateur.title: Dictator
LanguageData.Geopol_President.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was elected president of {PAWN_possessive} country. This proves {PAWN_possessive} great social and intellectual abilities, but {PAWN_pronoun} will no longer agree to do menial tasks such as cleaning or transporting objects.
LanguageData.Geopol_President.title: President
LanguageData.Geopol_Roi.baseDesc: A member of the royal family, [PAWN_nameDef] ended up being crowned on the death of {PAWN_possessive} predecessor. Having never had to work in {PAWN_possessive} life, {PAWN_pronoun} will be unable to perform any task with {PAWN_possessive} hands.
LanguageData.Geopol_Roi.title: King
LanguageData.Geopol_Pretre.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has decided to dedicate {PAWN_possessive} life to God and the Christian religion.
LanguageData.Geopol_Pretre.title: Priest
LanguageData.Geopol_Eveque.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a dignitary of the Christian church, {PAWN_pronoun} was chosen and rewarded by the pope to be in charge of a diocese. This responsibility tended to make {Pawn_objective} greedy. {PAWN_pronoun} isn't good to fight, and refuse to work at any task that {PAWN_pronoun} deems degrading.
LanguageData.Geopol_Eveque.title: Bishop
LanguageData.Geopol_Cardinal.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a high dignitary in the Catholic Church, {PAWN_pronoun} was chosen by the Pope and is in charge of assisting him. This responsibility tended to make {Pawn_objective} greedy. {PAWN_pronoun} isn't good to fight, and refuse to work at any task that {PAWN_pronoun} deems degrading.
LanguageData.Geopol_Cardinal.title: Cardinal
LanguageData.Geopol_Pape.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is the Bishop of Rome, head of the Catholic Church and monarchical head of state of the Vatican. Wishing for peace between peoples, [PAWN_nameDef] never learned to use violence.
LanguageData.Geopol_Pape.title: Pope
LanguageData.Geopol_Casseur.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent {PAWN_possessive} youth in high school and college protests breaking street furniture and shop windows. [PAWN_pronoun] has never stopped.
LanguageData.Geopol_Casseur.title: Rioter
LanguageData.Geopol_Eleve_religieux.baseDesc: From an early age, [PAWN_nameDef] was enrolled in a religious institution that instilled in [PAWN_objective] everything [PAWN_pronoun] believes in today.
LanguageData.Geopol_Eleve_religieux.title: Religious student
LanguageData.Geopol_Rebelle.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has always had the spirit of contradiction. From an early age [PAWN_pronoun] learned to go against the established order, it is for [PAWN_objective] something natural.
LanguageData.Geopol_Rebelle.title: Rebel
LanguageData.Geopol_Tagueur.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent {PAWN_possessive} youth with a spray paint in {PAWN_possessive} hand tagging {PAWN_possessive} name or silly slogans on the walls of {PAWN_possessive} town, believing [PAWN_pronoun] possessed a certain artistic talent.
LanguageData.Geopol_Tagueur.title: Tagger
LanguageData.Geopol_Heritier_roi.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has been destined from birth to rule {PAWN_possessive} kingdom, {PAWN_possessive} entire upbringing has been based on that. [PAWN_pronoun] has therefore learned all the rules of decorum and received a good intellectual education, but will be unable to perform any manual work.
LanguageData.Geopol_Heritier_roi.title: Prince
LanguageData.Geopol_bon_eleve.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was a very good student at school, it allowed [PAWN_objective] to do great intellectual studies, but [PAWN_pronoun] will be unable to do any manual work.
LanguageData.Geopol_bon_eleve.title: Good student
